name: tx_by_date_range
description: Log in with the given username and password, open the Find Transactions page, select the given account in the Account dropdown, enter the start date in the From date field and the end date in the To date field, click the FIND TRANSACTIONS button in the date range section, and read the whole Transaction Results table into an output named transactions

approved_plan.goal: Log in with the given username and password, open the Find Transactions page, select the given account in the Account dropdown, enter the start date in the From date field and the end date in the To date field, click the FIND TRANSACTIONS button in the date range section, and read the whole Transaction Results table into an output named transactions

steps.intent: Log in with the supplied username and password and reach the Accounts Overview page
steps.action: Replay reusable fragment parabank_login@1.0.0 using the supplied username and password

steps.intent: Navigate to the Find Transactions page
steps.action: Locate and click the 'Find Transactions' link in the navigation or sidebar menu

steps.intent: Select the given account in the Account dropdown
steps.action: Find the Account dropdown on the Find Transactions page and select the option matching account_id

steps.intent: Enter the start date in the From date field
steps.action: Locate the From date field in the date range section and type start_date into it

steps.intent: Enter the end date in the To date field
steps.action: Locate the To date field in the date range section and type end_date into it

steps.intent: Click the FIND TRANSACTIONS button in the date range section
steps.action: Locate and click the FIND TRANSACTIONS button that is associated with the date range section

steps.intent: Read the entire Transaction Results table into the transactions output
steps.action: Capture all rows and columns of the Transaction Results table that appears after the search and store as the transactions output
